text:
Alex: Hey team — can we lock the RFC review order for Thursday? We have 3 authors: Priya (KV cache), Marco (routing fallback), Jen (batching heuristics). I can host but need reviewer assignments and pre-read pings by Wed EOD. I'd also like to try a new two-pass timebox: 15m presentation + 15m discussion per RFC.

Priya: I can take KV cache. Morning PST preferred. Pre-read link: https://docs.redwood.com/rfcs/kv-cache-draft — will add a tl;dr and perf numbers.

Marco: Happy to review Priya. Afternoon PST better for me but can adjust if we start before noon.

Jen: I might be traveling Thu morning. If we hold Jen earlier I can do a 10:00–10:30 slot; otherwise I can record a 5-min walkthrough and post it.

Sam: I can review Jen and take notes. Quick thought — Marco has more conflicts; maybe put Marco later in the agenda so he can join remotely.

Alex: Proposed order so far: 1) Jen (if she can do 10am), 2) Priya, 3) Marco. If Jen records, we can play the recording and jump to discussion. Can everyone confirm availability?

Jen: I can do 10:00–10:30 PST. I'll post the pre-read and a 3-slide TL;DR by EOD today.

Priya: 10am works for me too. I'll add a short 'what to look for' checklist in the RFC (consistency, invalidation semantics, perf delta).

calendar-bot: Thu 10:00–11:30 PST — "RFC review sync" added. Invites sent to Alex, Priya, Marco, Jen, Sam.

Alex: Great. Action items: Jen — post pre-read + 3-slide TL;DR; Priya — add checklist + perf numbers; Marco — confirm reviewer assignments for Priya & Jen; Sam — notes. Also limit slides/code to tiny demos (3 slides or <1 min demo).

Marco: Confirmed — I'll review both Priya and Jen. Will leave comments in the PR by Wed 9am.

Sam: I'll be note-taker and capture decisions/action items. Proposal: strict 15m presentation / 15m discussion so we don't run over.

Alex: Done — 15/15 timebox. Also add a short 'regressions to watch' section in the notes template. Include links to perf runs and a minimal repro if available.

Jen: Pre-read posted: https://docs.redwood.com/rfcs/batching-heuristics-draft — attached demo gif and short checklist.

Priya: Pre-read updated with perf numbers and checklist.

Alex: Awesome. One more: if anyone needs a backup 'canary reviewer' I can step in if someone drops last minute.

Priya: We're covered, thanks.

Marco: Thanks everyone — see you Thu. :thumbsup:

Alex: Quick reminder ping (Wed 09:15 PST): please post any final comments by 12:00 PST so we can consolidate before the call.

Jen: Final comments posted.

Sam: Notes template pre-filled with sections: summary, decisions, action-items, regressions. I'll link it in the meeting thread.

Alex: Final reminder — pre-reads posted + calendar invite. Meeting starts 10:00 PST tomorrow. See ya. :wave:
